sentences.text: 從帽子裡變出鳥，好驚奇！
sentences.spokenText: 從帽子裡變出鳥好驚奇
sentences.imageNotes: 室內小小魔術表演場景，主角小女孩看著一位表演者從黑色帽子裡變出一隻小鳥，表情驚奇開心。小鳥從帽子裡飛出來，畫面清楚表現「變出鳥」。不要舞台文字、招牌、數字或可讀標籤。

Mandatory reference 1 is the entire approved L058 set, STYLE ONLY: warm bright natural light, fine pencil-and-watercolor, rich opaque painted forms and subtle paper texture, detailed but clean environments, soft natural faces, stable preschool body proportions. No anime, flat cartoon, thin watercolor wash, 3D render, photorealism, photographic bokeh, or text. Reference 2 is refined proportions and cast identity: girl top-left and mother upper-middle/center-left; preserve those identities. Girl: short dark bob with pink clip, pink cardigan, cream top, navy skirt, pink shoes, yellow bag. No letters, numbers, signage, logos, brands, labels, speech bubbles, symbols, watermarks. Small indoor magic show. A DISTINCT generic older male performer with curly gray hair and a neat short gray beard, burgundy vest over white shirt, holds an open black top hat. ONE small white bird is flying upward out of the hat, wings spread, feet just above its opening. The recurring girl stands nearby with delighted surprised open mouth and raised hands. Modest room with warm wood floor and muted green curtains, daylight. Performer not protagonist father; no other family members.

sentences.text: 怪物玩具讓我大吃一驚。
sentences.spokenText: 怪物玩具讓我大吃一驚
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩打開盒子或看到桌上的怪物玩具，被嚇一跳、往後退一點。怪物是玩具，要可愛、不恐怖，有玩具材質感。畫面表現「看到怪物玩具而吃驚」，不要恐怖電影感。

sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩手上只有一點點小擦傷，沒有流血或嚴重受傷；主角媽媽在旁邊表情很緊張，拿著小藥盒或 OK 繃準備處理。主角小女孩反而有點困惑或安撫媽媽。畫面要表現「小事被媽媽反應得很大」，不要恐怖、不要嚴重受傷。

sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩站在家門口或院子旁，一隻小狗突然從門後或草叢旁跑出來，女孩露出吃驚表情但沒有害怕大哭。小狗要友善可愛，動作明顯。不要危險追逐、不要攻擊感。
